author: Linnaeus, 1758
habitat: 하천, 저수지, 논, 강의 얕은 물가

months.note: 봄과 가을에 지나가며, 일부는 겨울에 머문다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 찾아오는 나그네새이며, 일부는 겨울에도 머무는 겨울철새이다. 하천, 저수지, 논, 강처럼 물이 얕은 물가에서 볼 수 있다. 쉬지 않고 움직이며 물 가장자리를 따라 진흙 속의 작은 무척추동물을 잡는다.

points.en: head and breast clearly streaked brown (breeding)
tail with two or three broad black bars

points.ko: 날 때 어두운 갈색으로 보이는 날개 아랫면

art.subject: Green Sandpiper (Tringa ochropus), adult in breeding plumage: greenish-brown upperparts, white in front of the eye forming a short supercilium and white around the eye, head and breast clearly streaked brown, tail with two or three broad black bars, dark brown underwing
art.pose: walking busily along the muddy edge of a stream, picking small invertebrates from the mud
art.scene: Korean shallow stream and reservoir edge with muddy margins in winter; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing: greenish-brown upperparts, white fore-supercilium and eye-ring, brown-streaked head and breast
adult winter, side view standing: fainter streaks on head and breast
in flight, from below: dark brown underwing, tail with 2–3 broad black bars
